sources.title: Majithia Lab
headings: Our mission is to develop new ways to detect and treat insulin resistance.
sources.text: Our mission is to develop new ways to detect and treat insulin resistance. Insulin resistance causes the epidemic diseases of our era, but it is invisible even to trained clinical eyes. We apply the tools of functional genomics, bioinformatics, and human genetics in a collaborative, multi-disciplinary research environment to identify and treat people with insulin resistance. Click here to learn more!

sources.title: Contact
sources.text: Contact Email Email: majithialab@health.ucsd.edu Location UC San Diego, School of Medicine Israni Biomedical Research Facility (IBRF) Office 3A19 Driving Directions Please note that "9500 Gilman Drive" is a singular address for the entire UC San Diego campus, it will not bring you to our actual building. We recommend using this Google Map or navigating to the nearest major cross streets: Gilman Drive and Osler Lane. ​From Gilman Drive, turn EAST onto Osler Lane. Continue heading EAST on Osler Lane until you reach the Israni Biomedical Research Facility (IBRF) building. UCSD Campus Map Visitor Parking Nearest visitor parking spaces are located in the Osler Parking Structure (within short walking distance to the IBRF building), Gilman Parking Structure , or lots P603 , P602 . A UC San Diego Parking Permit is required and may be purchased from Pay Stations in hourly or daily increments. Pay stations accept credit cards or exact cash. As of Oct 2018, rates are $3/hour or $30/day. Valet Parking Valet Service is available weekdays from 7:30AM – 6:00PM, the visitor rate is $30/day. The nearest valet lot is located in P610 on Osler Lane , within short walking distance to the IBRF building. Accessible Parking If you have a Disabled Person (DP) placard or license plates, you may park in these spaces without a parking permit: Handicap-accessible spaces designated by the wheelchair symbol, metered spaces (no fee required), or parking spaces marked S, B or A (no permit required).
